backend/servers/api-server/src/services/actions/delay.rs:54-61 — DelayConfig::to_duration() computes self.duration * 3600 / * 86400 on raw untrusted u64 with no checked_mul/saturating_mul.

delay.rs:100-108 (execute) and 144-150 (validate_config) — both call to_duration() first then check duration.as_secs() > MAX_DELAY_SECONDS (604800s/7d), so the cap check runs on an already-wrapped value.

Reproducer: {"duration": 144115188075855872, "unit": "days"} wraps duration * 86400 to exactly 0 (mod 2^64), passes both validate_config and execute-time <=604800s check, collapses to 0-second delay — the overflow defeats the very bound the check exists to enforce.
Debug builds (overflow-checks default on) panic instead of wrapping ('attempt to multiply with overflow') — a crafted delay config can crash the executing task in non-release builds.
